The oracle now matches the public expectations. Now let me use the oracle for differential fuzzing against gateway.py with a generator that produces many plausible requests.

Note the oracle has some simplifications that may be *wrong* relative to the spec (e.g., CSEQ_RE `([^\t]*)` allows spaces in the method — but I compare `m2.group(3) != method` so ok; BARE_RE's uri `[^ \t<>;]+` then norm_uri validates). Where they differ in interpretation, diffs will show up and I'll adjudicate each one against the spec.

Let me write the differential fuzzer: generate random batches with random directories/accounts/gateways and random requests built from valid + mutated pieces, run both, compare.

Also, I need to handle that the oracle's `parse` handles content-length required (my check `if nm not in got and nm != "content-length"` — content-length validated inline; if the field is missing entirely, the oracle doesn't catch it! Let me check: the REQUIRED loop skips content-length... that's a bug in the oracle: a missing Content-Length wouldn't be flagged. Let me fix: track presence of content-length separately.

Let me fix that and then run the differential fuzzer.

import random, sys, json
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/tmp')
import gateway, oracle

SPECS = [
  ({"sip:ember@studio.test": ["sip:e1@alias.studio.test", "tel:+12025550121"],
    "sip:desk@sales.test": ["tel:+12025550122"],
    "sip:trunk@trunk.test": [],
    "sip:anon2@other.test": []},
   {"s1": {"primary":"sip:ember@studio.test","allow":["sip:desk@sales.test"]},
    "s2": {"primary":"sip:trunk@trunk.test","allow":[]},
    "s3": {"primary":"sip:desk@sales.test","allow":["sip:ember@studio.test"]}},
   {"edge": {"local_domains":["studio.test","sales.test"],"peers":{"p1":["trunk.test"],"p2":["studio.test","sales.test"]}},
    "inside": {"local_domains":[],"peers":{"edge":["studio.test"]}},
    "wide": {"local_domains":["other.test"],"peers":{"edge":["studio.test","sales.test"],"p2":["sales.test"]}}}),
]

def rand_batch(rng, njobs):
    spec = SPECS[0]
    DIR, ACC, GW = spec
    ident_pool = list(DIR) + [a for v in DIR.values() for a in v] + \
        ["sip:unknown@studio.test","sip:ember@STUDIO.TEST.","tel:+19999999999","sip:a@b", "sip:x@y.z"]
    def uri():
        c = rng.choice(ident_pool)
        if rng.random() < .25 and c.startswith("sip:"):
            u, h = c.split("@",1)
            c = u + "@" + h.upper()
            if rng.random() < .5: c += "."
        if rng.random() < .15 and c.startswith("sip:"):
            # escape a char
            u = c[4:].split("@")[0]
            if u and u[0].isalnum():
                c = "sip:%" + "%02X" % ord(u[0]) + u[1:] + "@" + c[4:][len(u)+1:]
        return c
    def addr(p=True):
        u = uri()
        style = rng.random()
        if style < .4: v = "<%s>" % u
        elif style < .55: v = "%s" % u
        elif style < .7: v = "%s < %s >" % (rng.choice(["Alice","A B","\"q t\"","\"a;b\"","X"]), u)
        elif style < .8: v = "\"esc \\\" here\" <%s>" % u
        else: v = "<%s>" % u
        if p and rng.random() < .3:
            v += rng.choice([";tag=q7"," ; tag = %s" % rng.choice(["a"*rng.randint(1,140), "T-9"]) ," ;TAG= x ",";tag=",";foo=1",";tag=bad space"])
        if rng.random() < .12: v += rng.choice([", "+addr(p=False), " extra", "x"])
        return v
    def hdr_val_identity():
        return addr(p=False)
    jobs = []
    for k in range(njobs):
        lines = []
        method = rng.choice(["MESSAGE","INVITE","MESSAGE"])
        lines.append("%s %s SIP/2.0" % (method, uri() if rng.random()<.9 else "sip:i@r.t"))
        names = []
        def add(nm, val):
            lines.append("%s: %s" % (nm, val)); names.append(nm)
        add(rng.choice(["From","from","f","F","From"]), addr())
        add(rng.choice(["To","TO","t"]), addr())
        add(rng.choice(["Call-ID","i","CALL-ID"]), rng.choice(["c","cid_1","a"*rng.randint(1,130),"bad id","x"*128,""]))
        add("CSeq", rng.choice(["%s %s"%(rng.choice(["1","0001","0","2147483647","2147483648","9"*20]), method),
                                "1  %s"%method, "1\t%s"%method, "%s %s"%(rng.choice(["9","10"]), rng.choice(["MESSAGE","INVITE","OPTIONS"]))]))
        if rng.random() < .5: add(rng.choice(["Privacy"]), rng.choice(["id","none","ID","NoNe","x","", "id,none"]))
        if rng.random() < .4: add(rng.choice(["P-Asserted-Identity","p-asserted-identity"]),
                                  ",".join(hdr_val_identity() for _ in range(rng.randint(1,3))))
        if rng.random() < .3: add("P-Preferred-Identity", hdr_val_identity())
        if rng.random() < .2: add("Remote-Party-ID", hdr_val_identity())
        if rng.random() < .3: add(rng.choice(["Content-Type","c"]), rng.choice(["text/plain","application/x-y","", "a\tb", "x"*200]))
        if rng.random() < .25: add(rng.choice(["Via","Authorization","Contact","X-Foo","Record-Route"]), "<sip:a@b>;tag=z")
        if rng.random() < .15: lines.append(rng.choice([" ","\t"]) + "folded " + uri())
        if rng.random() < .1: add(rng.choice(["From","To","Call-ID","CSeq","Content-Length","Privacy","Content-Type"]), "dup")
        body = rng.choice(["hello","", "a\r\nb", "\t x\x7f", chr(233), "z"*rng.randint(1,200)])
        blen = len(body.encode('latin1')) if all(ord(c)<256 for c in body) else -1
        lines.append("Content-Length: %d" % (len(body) if rng.random()<.85 else rng.randint(0,20)))
        text = "\r\n".join(lines) + "\r\n\r\n" + body
        if rng.random() < .3:
            cl = list(text)
            for _ in range(rng.randint(1,3)):
                i = rng.randrange(len(cl))
                op = rng.random()
                ch = rng.choice(list('\r\n\t "<>;,=\\%*!@.\'`0zS\x00\x7f'+chr(233)))
                if op < .4: cl[i] = ch
                elif op < .7: cl.insert(i, ch)
                else: del cl[i]
            text = "".join(cl)
        job = {"gateway": rng.choice(list(GW)+["nope"]),
               "ingress": rng.choice([{"kind":"local","subject":rng.choice(list(ACC)+["nope"])},
                                      {"kind":"peer","name":rng.choice(["p1","p2","edge","nope"])},
                                      {"kind":"untrusted"}]),
               "trusted_out": rng.random() < .5}
        if k > 0 and rng.random() < .2:
            job["source"] = rng.randrange(k)
        else:
            job["raw"] = text
        jobs.append(job)
    return {"directory": DIR, "accounts": ACC, "gateways": GW, "jobs": jobs}

gateway.Context  # ensure exists
diffs = 0
checked = 0
random.seed(777)
for it in range(3000):
    rng = random.Random(it*101+3)
    b = rand_batch(rng, rng.randint(1,6))
    g1 = gateway.process(b)
    g2 = oracle.process(b)
    checked += len(b["jobs"])
    if g1 != g2:
        diffs += 1
        if diffs <= 6:
            for i,(x,y) in enumerate(zip(g1["results"], g2["results"])):
                if x != y:
                    print("=== batch", it, "job", i)
                    print(json.dumps(b["jobs"][i])[:900])
                    print("gateway:", json.dumps(x)[:300])
                    print("oracle :", json.dumps(y)[:300])
print("jobs checked", checked, "diff batches", diffs)
PYEOF
cd /workspace/tmp && python3 diff_fuzz.py 2>&1 | tail -50
